| A11Y-001 | WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3 — Contrast Minimum | Critical | `<button class="btn-secondary">` | `src/components/InvoiceTable.tsx:34` | Change button text color from `#9E9E9E` to `#595959` — achieves 4.5:1 ratio on white background |
| A11Y-002 | WCAG 2.1 SC 2.4.7 — Focus Visible | Serious | `<input id="search-filter">` | `src/components/FilterBar.tsx:18` | Add `:focus { outline: 2px solid #0066CC; outline-offset: 2px }` — focus is currently hidden via `outline: none` |
| A11Y-003 | WCAG 2.1 SC 1.1.1 — Non-text Content | Moderate | `<img class="vendor-logo">` | `src/components/VendorCard.tsx:7` | Add descriptive `alt` attribute: `alt="[Vendor Name] logo"` |
